lanes.stop_condition: BLOCKED on candidate dirt/SHA mismatch/excluded path/timeout/nonzero dry-run/cleanup failure; otherwise DONE only after exact owned worktree removal.
BLOCKED_CONFIG_INVENTORY_MISMATCH on unknown canonical input, count/name mismatch, secret-bearing output, or ambiguous/non-idempotent intended diff.
BLOCKED on pre-check failure, diff expansion, budget UNKNOWN/overrun, sync/check failure, secret exposure, or any non-owned write.

READY_FOR_PROD only when exact SHA, A/B evidence, zero-leak scan, and reviewer verdict pass; otherwise typed BLOCKED. Each command is capped at 120 seconds, then terminated with no more than 10 seconds wait.
